scope: Descriptive full-history D1 fits at cutoff; previously viewed history, not fresh predictive evidence; HAC20 approximate

protocol.refit: monthly; train only labels with end strictly before first forecast origin
protocol.data_rules: Fresh raw extract must match class mapping, units and schema, include calendar/source checks, log actual retrieval and availability timestamps and immutable hash before each forecast; no backdating or current-vintage replay as real time. No automatic fetch or scheduler.
